policies.title: Eswatini ordinary passports: Grenada visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Grenada's actively linked April 2024 Embassy schedule lists Swaziland as requiring no visitor visa.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Eswatini passport holder travelling to Grenada as a short visitor.
The schedule's no-visa category means a visa is not required; work, study, residence, transit, diplomatic, official, service and special-document treatment remain outside scope.
The actively linked schedule was updated April 2024 and should be rechecked if Grenada publishes a replacement.

policies.title: Eswatini ordinary passports: Panama stamped visitor visa
policies.summary: Panama's live Embassy schedule places Swaziland in the Stamped Visa roster, requiring advance approval and a passport stamp before travel.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Eswatini passport holder travelling as a short visitor who does not independently qualify for a document-based waiver.
Panama's Stamped Visa process requires advance review; if granted, the applicant must attend the Embassy to have the passport stamped.
The source says approval can take up to 30 business days. Work, residence, transit, diplomatic, official and special-document routes remain outside scope.

policies.title: Eswatini ordinary passports: Jordan advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Jordan's live Tourism Board table directs Swaziland passport holders to obtain a visa from the closest Jordanian Embassy before arrival.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Eswatini passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
The source says the Swaziland row is not applicable for arrival issuance and directs the traveller to obtain a visa before arrival.
All non-Jordanians must obtain a Gateway2Jordan QR code before departure; work, residence, transit, special documents, border-crossing limits and final admission remain outside scope.
